content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) advises that there should be greater transparency in the pricing of medications. This includes implementing cost-sharing models that guarantee patients are charged a reasonable and equitable price for essential drugs. The ADA emphasizes the importance of reducing administrative complexities, such as excessive paperwork, which can create barriers for patients attempting to access their medications. Simplifying these processes can significantly improve medication accessibility. In recent years, advocacy efforts have led to notable progress, with several major insulin manufacturers reducing the prices of insulin. This has improved access for many individuals who rely on this life-saving medication.
